summary.text: Richard Mason is a Republican member of the Maine House of Representatives from District 97 who is the Republican candidate for the Maine State Senate, District 17, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is not running for re-election to the House in 2026.

paragraphs.text: Richard Mason lives in Lisbon, Maine, and his career experience includes owning a business.
Ballotpedia lists him as having assumed office in the Maine House of Representatives on December 6, 2022, representing District 97, with his current term ending on December 1, 2026.
In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Bills in the Second Reading Committee as Ranking Member.
He advanced from the Republican primary for Senate District 17 on June 9, 2026.
